method: For each pair, candidate as_of instants are drawn from the axis the requested rate_semantics actually governs itself on (FX-45H section 5): ANNOUNCED samples every real stored vintage's own released_at (both legs, every confidence tier); EFFECTIVE samples every real stored vintage's own POPULATED effective_at instead. Each candidate is queried through ComputePolicyRateDifferential -- the same use case the real feature uses, not bespoke coverage logic. This report contains no FX returns, expectancy, correlation, significance, or trading-performance figures.
